title: feat(spec): export the controlled_by_parent exactly-one-master predicate; lint reads it
body:
Fixes #23272

Clause-②: yes

## What

`@objectstack/spec/data` now exports the `controlled_by_parent` exactly-one-master predicate (ADR-0055 §1), from the module that owns it (`packages/spec/src/data/controlled-by-parent-master.ts`). `ObjectSchema`'s refusal and `@objectstack/lint`'s `cbpMasterCandidates` read it, so a producer, the parse and the linter cannot drift.

- **`controlledByParentMasterRefusal(objectName, sharingModel, fields)`** (already the parse's judge, now public with its types `ControlledByParentMasterRefusal` and `ControlledByParentMasterShape`) answers the object-level question "does this object satisfy the exactly-one-master rule?". `undefined` means yes. A refusal carries the parse issue's `path` and `message`, the object's `shape`, and its `master_detail` and required `lookup` fields.
- **`isControlledByParentMasterField(field)`** (new) answers the field-level half, "does this field count as the master?": a `master_detail` declared `required: true`, and nothing else. The refusal now counts with it.

## Why these two, and not one

The card's direction asks for one predicate that both `ObjectSchema` and the lint read. Measured on `main`, they need different granularity:

- The **producer** (cloud's `packages/service-ai-studio/src/tools/sharing-model.ts`, `defaultSharingModel`) needs the object-level verdict for a field map it is about to write: `controlledByParentMasterRefusal(name, 'controlled_by_parent', fields) === undefined`. The refusal function already returns exactly that, along with the shape and message, so no narrower boolean wrapper is added.
- **The lint** cannot read only the object verdict without changing findings. `cbpMasterCandidates` lists each candidate with its `reference` for the ambiguous-relation message. It reads the array field form as well as the map. It also does not count a `master_detail` that names no `reference` (pinned by `errors when the required master_detail names no reference target` and `picks up a later relation when an earlier one names no target`). So the lint reads the field-level predicate, which is the part the refusal counts, and keeps its `refOf` filter and its own `length` checks for its two rule ids.

What counts as a master is now spelled once, in the spec.

## Landing spot

This is the claim's file surface. The owning module is `controlled-by-parent-master.ts`, not `object.zod.ts` as the card says. `object.zod.ts` already called it, so `object.zod.ts` is unchanged. The re-export is in `packages/spec/src/data/index.ts`. Dependency direction: `@objectstack/lint` already imports `@objectstack/spec/data` (`referenceCarrierOf`), so no new edge and no cycle.

## Pins

- `packages/spec/src/data/controlled-by-parent-master.test.ts` (new) imports through the `data` entry. For each shape #23270 lists (`several-required-masters`, `several-masters`, `master-not-required` with `required: false` and with `required` omitted, `required-lookup-only`, `no-master`), plus the two satisfying shapes, the export and `ObjectSchema.safeParse` agree on the verdict, the issue path and the message. A satisfying shape parses whole. Any other sharing model gets `undefined` from the export and is accepted by the parse. A truth table covers the field predicate, and a test shows that the refusal's verdict is "exactly one field counts".
- `packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.test.ts`: the #5017 receiver meta-test row for `f` drops `required`. The lint no longer reads `f.required` itself, because the spec predicate reads it. All lint findings, paths and texts are unchanged: every existing cbp test passes without edits.

## Ablation (run once, not kept)

The fix was committed first. `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` then made `isControlledByParentMasterField` also count a required `lookup` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `1500e7c092d0` → `f3afdbb79519`), and the spec was rebuilt. `ablation-dist-preflight` found the marker in 24 built files, which proves the lint resolves through `dist/`.
- `validate-security-posture.test.ts`: **6 failed** (e.g. `errors on a REQUIRED lookup (the retired third tier)`, `the parse and the lint agree on a required lookup`). So the lint reads the spec predicate.
- `controlled-by-parent-master.test.ts`: **3 failed** (`a required lookup only`, `one required master_detail beside a lookup`, and the field truth-table row).
- Restore: blob equals HEAD (`1500e7c092d0`), `git diff HEAD` is empty, the spec was rebuilt, and `--absent` found the marker in none of 232 built files. The tree is clean.

## Tests and gates

All readings below are at head `d88df525c`, after the merge of `origin/main`. Every heavy run went through `os-verify-lock.sh`.

- `pnpm --filter "@objectstack/lint..." build`: exit 0. This also rebuilt `@objectstack/spec`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date". `api-surface/data.json` and `export-origins/data.json` were regenerated in this PR: three functions and types added to the `data` entry, nothing removed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: 677 files, **20599 passed** | 1 todo.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test:repo`: 60 files, **1029 passed**. This was run at the pre-merge head `7c40b9b6b`. The merge brought nothing into the files this PR touches.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: 139 files, **6726 passed**.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck`: exit 0. These ran before the merge, and the merge did not touch `spec/src/data` or `lint/src`.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 88 derived families, all exit 0. The `--ran` reconcile says "88 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 88 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)".
- `check:nul-bytes`: exit 0.
- Consumers: no accept or refuse result changes in `packages/spec`. The refusal function body only swaps an inline filter for the extracted predicate, as the 20599 spec tests and the new pin show. So no consumer package owes a re-run beyond `@objectstack/lint`, which is the one importer of the new export.

## Acceptance notes

- The runtime's `resolveCbpRelation` (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts`) still keeps its own reading. It reads the unparsed registry with the reference aliases, and this card's direction names only the parse and the lint. Not changed here. carrier: none.
- `controlledByParentMasterRefusal` answers `undefined` when `fields` is not an object map, as it did before. A producer must pass the field map it writes. The JSDoc and the changeset say so.
- Cloud's `defaultSharingModel` (at cloud `main` today) counts any `master_detail` with `required !== false`, and so treats an omitted `required` as a master. `ObjectSchema` treats that as `master-not-required` on the authoring path. Adopting the export makes cloud's answer the parse's. That adoption is cloud's change, not this PR's.
